panels.title: Token Usage Detail — Selected Time Range

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.output_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range]))

(sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.output_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range]))) / (sum(count_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type" | type="assistant" [$__range])))

sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) / (sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])))
sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.output_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range]))

sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.output_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) / sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.output_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", v="message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__interval]))

sum by (model) (sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", model="message.model", v="message.usage.input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum by (model) (sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", model="message.model", v="message.usage.output_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum by (model) (sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", model="message.model", v="message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range])) + sum by (model) (sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", model="message.model", v="message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | unwrap v [$__range]))

sum by (project) (sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", cwd="cwd", v="message.usage.input_tokens" | type="assistant" | label_format project=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/" .cwd "" }}` | unwrap v [$__range]))

sum by (project) (sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", cwd="cwd", v="message.usage.output_tokens" | type="assistant" | label_format project=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/" .cwd "" }}` | unwrap v [$__range]))

sum by (project) (sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", cwd="cwd", v="message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | label_format project=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/" .cwd "" }}` | unwrap v [$__range]))

sum by (project) (sum_over_time({job="claude-code"} | json type="type", cwd="cwd", v="message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens" | type="assistant" | label_format project=`{{ regexReplaceAll ".*/" .cwd "" }}` | unwrap v [$__range]))
